quotes.text: The version-specific onContactUpdated listener awaits fire.wakeup, then uses context.extension. Its convert(newFire, extContext) callback replaces both values after a Manifest V3 background restart. Manifest V3 reports the old vCard string as the second event argument; Manifest V2 reports changed flat properties. A listener that retains the old context can use the wrong version or a shut-down background.
